## Verdict: APPROVE WITH ADVISORY NOTES (iteration 3 — fix delta is correct; the two prior Important findings are resolved; no new blockers)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #251: Add an opt-in permissive near-match context tier — criteria from issue-body; scope unchanged. Requirement-based checklist items are included in the verification results below. This PR has no workpad criteria to use, so the issue body's `## Acceptance Criteria` section supplied them. AC1-AC6 are implemented and verified; AC7 (docs/internal/agent/memory.md) is intentionally DEFERRED for this PR by a recorded prior decision and is not graded a defect.

Coverage: checklist not capped (16 of 16 kept); coverage shortfall dropped_count=0.

## Code Review Findings

### 🟠 Important / Major
1. MemoryConfig does not enforce the cross-field ordering invariant context_similarity_threshold <= similarity_threshold; a transposed pair is silently coerced (band off; text floor collapses to the lower value), injecting text far more permissively than intended. A @model_validator rejecting context>strict would make the illegal state unrepresentable. (raised by 1/7 agents) — advisory at the 'critical' threshold; not an AC violation (AC3 band-empty holds).
2. DefaultLlmContextEnhancer.__init__ accepts the two thresholds as unvalidated public mutable floats on a public construction seam (factory constructs it directly); no bounds or ordering check on this type. (raised by 1/7 agents) — advisory at 'critical'.
3. The strict-tier exclusion boundary (r.similarity_score < strict) is not pinned at the exact endpoint — the exclusion test uses 0.9, so a '<'→'<=' mutation escapes; a pair at score == similarity_threshold is never tested. (raised by 1/7 agents) — advisory at 'critical'.

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. Comment cross-reference default.py:11-12 names MemoryConfig._DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, but the symbol is the module-level sqllens.config._DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD (not a class attribute). Behavior-inert prose (no tool reads it; not shipped), so capped at Suggestion under the 4.1.5 inertness cap and non-blocking. (raised by 3/7 agents)
2. The band relationship is derived inline three times rather than captured as a small immutable value object (ContextBand). (raised by 1/7 agents)
3. 'single source of truth' wording overstates the reality — two independently-written 0.7 literals exist across the config/agent boundary; soften the wording or add an equality test. (raised by 1/7 agents)
4. _StubAgentMemory re-implements the real '>=' gate, duplicating the inclusivity contract untested against ChromaAgentMemory. (raised by 1/7 agents)
5. Band pair filter uses truthiness (args.get('sql')); a present-but-empty '' sql is dropped like a missing key — intentional and pinned, not a silent-drop defect. (raised by 1/7 agents)
6. Test hardening: band-search degrade path, falsy-but-present sql arg, AC5 no-tool-call assertion, and the score==context_floor lower boundary are each unpinned. (raised by 1/7 agents)

truthfulness sweep: no finding promoted — the default.py:11-12 comment inaccuracy is behavior-inert prose covered by the 4.1.5 cap, so it is excluded from the self-contradicting-diff carve-out and stays a Suggestion.

## Verdict Criteria
- Verification checklist: 16 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 INCONCLUSIVE → no REJECT from rules 1/2.
- Coverage shortfall: dropped_count=0 → contributes nothing (rule 2a).
- Unmet-decided-criterion carve-out: none — AC1-AC6 verified, AC7 deferred by design.
- Self-contradicting-diff carve-out: none — the only diff-added prose inaccuracy (default.py:11-12) is behavior-inert (both 4.1.5 limbs hold) and capped at Suggestion.
- Findings at/above the 'critical' threshold: none (3 Important + several Suggestions, all below 'critical').
- All 7 Phase-3 agents returned (no partial-coverage note).
- Prior-iteration status: the two previously-Important findings — (a) single-sourcing the band-empty-by-default 0.7 default via _DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD, and (b) the min(context_floor, strict) text-floor regression test — are both confirmed RESOLVED with no regressions (corroborated by code-reviewer, requesting-code-review, and the fresh checklist verification of VC-3/VC-6/VC-16).

Result: only findings below the verdict threshold present → APPROVE WITH ADVISORY NOTES.

phase3_findings.description: MemoryConfig does not express or enforce the cross-field ordering invariant context_similarity_threshold <= similarity_threshold. A transposed pair (e.g. similarity_threshold=0.3, context_similarity_threshold=0.7) passes each field's independent [0,1] bound but is silently coerced: band disabled and text_search_floor=min(0.7,0.3)=0.3, injecting text at a far more permissive bar than the operator intends. A @model_validator(mode='after') rejecting context>strict (mirroring AuthConfig._bearer_requires_token in the same file) would make the illegal state unrepresentable. Advisory at the default 'critical' threshold; not an AC violation (AC3 band-empty holds).

DefaultLlmContextEnhancer.__init__ accepts the two thresholds as unvalidated public mutable floats. factory.build_agent constructs it directly (a public seam), so it is not reached only through the bounds-checked MemoryConfig; a direct caller can pass out-of-range or incoherent (context>strict) values and they are stored verbatim. The invariant lives nowhere on this type. Advisory at 'critical'.

The strict-tier pair exclusion boundary (band filter r.similarity_score < strict) is not pinned at the exact endpoint. The only exclusion test (test_band_excludes_strict_tier_pairs) uses a pair at 0.9 with strict=0.7, so a mutation of '<' to '<=' survives the suite; a pair scoring exactly == similarity_threshold (the reuse-vs-inject boundary AC5/AC6 no-duplication invariant depends on) is never tested. Add a pair at score == strict asserting it is NOT injected. Advisory at 'critical'.

Comment cross-reference names a symbol that does not resolve: default.py:11-12 says the constant 'mirrors MemoryConfig._DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD in sqllens.config', but _DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD is a MODULE-LEVEL constant (sqllens.config._DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD), not a MemoryConfig class attribute — the qualified name would AttributeError. Behavior-inert prose (no tool reads it, not shipped to consumers) so it is capped at Suggestion under the 4.1.5 inertness cap and does not drive REJECT; the constant genuinely exists in that module and the mirroring intent is correct.

The band relationship (band_enabled=context<strict, text_search_floor=min(context,strict), re-filter r.similarity_score<strict) is derived inline in enhance_system_prompt three times rather than captured as a value object; a small immutable ContextBand type would carry the invariant and remove the standing risk a future edit re-derives text_search_floor as a bare context_floor (the exact regression the min() guard test exists for).

'single source of truth' wording overstates the reality across the config/agent module boundary: there are two independently-written 0.7 literals (config.py and enhancer/default.py), kept in sync only by the enhancer's 'mirrors' comment. Defensible (the vendored agent/ package cannot import sqllens.config, and factory always passes explicit config values) but either soften the wording or add a test asserting the two constants are equal so a desync fails loudly.

_StubAgentMemory re-implements the real store's '>= similarity_threshold' gate, so the inclusive lower-bound / exclusive upper-bound boundary semantics live in two places; if ChromaAgentMemory ever switched to '>' the band tests would keep passing green. Worth a note that the inclusivity contract is duplicated and untested against the real implementation.

The band pair filter r.memory.args.get('sql') is truthiness-based, so a present-but-empty sql ('') is dropped identically to a missing key. Intentional and pinned by test_band_excludes_pairs_without_sql_arg; NOT a CLAUDE.md silent-drop defect (that rule targets bulk export/import completeness, whereas prompt enrichment is best-effort). Use 'sql' in args if empty-string SQL ever becomes meaningful.

Band-search degrade path is untested: test_search_failure_degrades_to_original_prompt raises only from search_text_memories (awaited first, short-circuiting before search_similar_usage). Same except handler, so low value, but a regression moving the band search outside the try would go uncaught. Also: falsy-but-present sql arg, AC5 prose-marker absence-of-tool-call assertion, and the score==context_floor lower-boundary inclusion are each unpinned. All advisory.

checklist.claim: AC1: MemoryConfig in src/sqllens/config.py carries a new float field context_similarity_threshold with pydantic Field bounds ge=0.0, le=1.0, defaulting to 0.7 (via _DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD).
AC2: context_similarity_threshold is settable via env SQLLENS_MEMORY__CONTEXT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD and via the [memory] TOML key, with env winning over TOML.

AC3: when context_similarity_threshold >= similarity_threshold the band is empty (band_enabled = context_floor < strict is False) and no extra memory is injected on account of the band; at the default 0.7/0.7 output is byte-identical to pre-change.

AC4: when context_similarity_threshold < similarity_threshold the enhancer injects memories scoring in [context_floor, strict) from both question->SQL pairs and text/schema-doc memories under the existing '## Relevant Context from Memory' heading.
AC5: injected near-match question->SQL pairs render as related example prose (prior question and its SQL), not as a pre-decided tool call.

AC6: question->SQL pairs with score >= similarity_threshold are excluded from the band (r.similarity_score < strict filter) and stay tool-only; text memories at or above strict remain injected as before.

AC7 (INTENTIONALLY DEFERRED): docs/internal/agent/memory.md updated to describe the injection path and context_similarity_threshold. Per this run's prior decision AC7 is deferred; missing docs must NOT be graded a code defect.
The enhancer calls search_text_memories with keyword-only similarity_threshold; the AgentMemory ABC declares that keyword-only parameter, so the call is signature-valid.
The enhancer calls search_similar_usage(question=..., context=..., limit=5, similarity_threshold=context_floor) with keyword-only args matching the AgentMemory ABC / ChromaAgentMemory signature.
The band render reads pair.args['sql'] guarded by isinstance(r.memory.args, dict) and r.memory.args.get('sql'); ToolMemory.args is typed Dict[str, Any] and question is str, so no unguarded deref.

factory.build_agent constructs DefaultLlmContextEnhancer(memory, similarity_threshold=cfg.memory.similarity_threshold, context_similarity_threshold=cfg.memory.context_similarity_threshold) and passes it to Agent(..., llm_context_enhancer=context_enhancer); Agent accepts that kwarg.
_StubAgentMemory's search_text_memories/search_similar_usage mirror the real AgentMemory keyword-only signatures and reproduce the real ChromaAgentMemory '>= similarity_threshold' lower-bound gate.
_StubAgentMemory implements all abstract AgentMemory methods (save_tool_usage, save_text_memory, get_recent_memories, etc.) so it instantiates, with signatures matching the ABC.

_render_text_only reproduces the exact pre-change text-only '## Relevant Context from Memory' section string, so the no-op assertions pin byte-identical output rather than self-referencing the code under test.

test_memory_thresholds_flow_into_context_enhancer asserts agent.llm_context_enhancer is a DefaultLlmContextEnhancer with similarity_threshold==0.6, context_similarity_threshold==0.3, and shares agent.agent_memory.

_DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD is defined as 0.7 in BOTH src/sqllens/config.py and src/sqllens/agent/core/enhancer/default.py (two independent literals across the vendored-agent boundary); each module's comment calls it a 'single source of truth' within that module.
